reviews.title: Best Orange Soda I've Ever Had
reviews.body: If you want a soda that's uniquely different and TASTES GREAT, you have to try this product! It is imported from Italy and contains REAL Blood Orange juice. It is somewhat similar to the artificially flavored orange sodas you might buy at the supermarket, but WAY better in my opinion. Artwork on the can is pretty cool too!

reviews.title: Fantastic!  Real juice and sugar and not too sweet.
reviews.body: I wish it was easier to get European soda and snacks here in the US.This taste is great but it is too expensive here on amazon for me to order it frequently.It tastes like a sweeter and carbonated version of Italian brand Volcano blood orange juice; which is the best.It has no nasty ingredients in it. It’s made with 18% real juice, which is typical for European juice flavored soft drinks, but much more juice than you would typically find in American juice flavored soft drinks.It’s made with real cane sugar, and has about half the amount of sugar in it as a typical soft drink would like a coke.  It has about as much sugar as fruit juice normally does.I have included photos of the ingredient list and nutrition label.

features: SICILIAN CITRUS DELIGHT: Immerse yourself in the tantalizing taste of our Sicilian coastal fruit beverages, delicately carbonated and sweetened to perfection. Sourced from orchards along the picturesque Sicilian coast, our drinks are a testament to the region's rich agricultural bounty. Each sip embodies the vibrant flavors of the Mediterranean, meticulously cultivated under the warm Sicilian sun and nourished by the fertile soil enriched by volcanic activity near Mt. Etna.

NATURE'S BOUNTY: Each of our fruit drinks is handpicked with utmost care, showcasing the essence of Sicily's pristine landscapes and favorable climate. From the moment our fruits are delicately plucked from the trees to the instance they grace your lips, they embark on a journey of meticulous craftsmanship and unwavering dedication. This meticulous process results in a sparkling beverage that beautifully encapsulates the pure essence of Sicily, delivering a taste experience that is Delicious.

ARTISANAL PACKAGING: Elevate your drinking experience with our meticulously designed cans and bottles, adorned with captivating artwork that pays homage to Sicily's rich cultural heritage. Inspired by the golden age of "la dolce vita," each packaging exudes an air of elegance and sophistication, inviting you to savor every moment of indulgence. Immerse yourself in the timeless charm of Sicilian craftsmanship and tradition as you enjoy our meticulously crafted beverages.

VOLCANIC ELIXIR: Enriched by the mineral-rich soil surrounding the majestic Mt. Etna, our sparkling beverage captures the unique essence of Sicily's volcanic landscape. The harmonious fusion of volcanic minerals and sun-ripened fruits results in a truly exceptional taste sensation, leaving your palate refreshed and invigorated with every sip. Immerse yourself in the rejuvenating experience of savoring our volcanic elixir, as it transports you to the heart of Sicily with every delightful sip.

THE SWEET LIFE IN EVERY SIP: With A' Siciliana, every sip is a celebration of Sicily's vibrant culture. From the sun-drenched citrus groves to the azure shores of the Mediterranean, our beverages embody the essence of the Sicilian lifestyle - vibrant, lively, and brimming with flavor. Indulge in the sweet life with A' Siciliana and experience the magic of Sicily in every sip. Immerse in the sensory journey through Sicily's captivating landscapes with each delightful sip of A' Siciliana.
